semantic_comparison.scope:
Finite original/source first-fit/wrap allocator comparisons in Unicorn.

Both allocators are leaf routines. All storage and readable capacities are
synthetic; no original OS module load, instruction patch or game startup occurs.
limits: Readable capacities and globals are synthetic; independent actual owner proof is separate. No native capacity or complete factory lifecycle follows.
Neither routine reserves a returned slot; cursor remains at the found index. Repeated-call controls preserve this behavior.

compiler_steering: Use direct globals in each scan and condition instead of captured locals; full contributions and native reference offsets then agree. Compact sparse slot views and actual owner names retain equality.
limits: No allocator reserves a slot or advances beyond the found index; physical pool capacities remain unproved.
HIGHLOW direct and adjacent-root accesses are classified; computed aliases are not exhaustively proved.
Existing historical source units, their accepted functions and headers remain unchanged; only reviewed unaccepted diagnostic rows migrate.
